title: Playboy March 2006 Jessica Alba Kanye West Interview Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Front cover has light wear along the spine edge. Back cover has a small tear at the bottom edge and a green sticker remnant at lower left (see photo 2).
description:
Playboy magazine, March 2006 - The Music Issue. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: Jessica Alba cover; Playboy Interview with Kanye West; 25 celebrities including Jennifer Garner, Angelina Jolie, Scarlett Johansson, Shakira, Denise Richards, Jaime Pressly and Holly, Bridget & Kendra; Playboy Music Awards (The Sounds, Fall Out Boy, Queens of the Stone Age, Sean Paul); Franz Ferdinand 20Q; Burt Bacharach; UFC's softer side with Willa Ford.

Back cover: HBO Big Love premiere ad (Bill Paxton).

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
